definitions.explanation: A short, straight haircut cut level around the head at about jaw length, usually with straight-cut bangs; traditionally a girl's style.

examples.japanese: おかっぱ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧おかっぱだった。
examples.english: I always had a bob when I was a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、おかっぱ{頭|あたま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦セーラー{服|ふく}→セーラー服：17677_seeraafuku⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写|うつ}っていた→写る：11494_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: In my grandmother's old photo, she had a bob and was wearing a sailor-style school uniform.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おかっぱ{頭|あたま}: bobbed hair
- おかっぱ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have one's hair cut in a bob

USAGE:
おかっぱ suggests a childlike, old-fashioned look (it is the hairstyle of ⟦{座敷|ざしき}→座敷：00433_zashiki⟧わらし and of many dolls). Hair salons today usually call the style ボブ.
